source_policy: Use exact-title scholarly discovery, then verify venue and metadata against an official conference, publisher, DOI, or preprint record. Do not promote a search-result venue without primary-source confirmation.
dataset_policy: Record separately the datasets used for self-supervised or backbone pretraining and the datasets used for downstream evaluation. Preserve named benchmark suites and explicitly label unnamed private collections.

records.normalized_title: efficient videomae via temporal progressive training

updates.method_description: A three-stage VideoMAE curriculum that progressively increases temporal coverage and masking difficulty while reusing learned weights.
updates.dataset_notes: The curriculum is trained and evaluated separately on Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2.
updates.audit_notes: The existing workshop label was retained and normalized to the official CVPR Workshops venue.

records.normalized_title: an empirical study of autoregressive pre training from videos

updates.method_description: Causal autoregressive next-token prediction over discrete visual tokens using a decoder-only transformer trained on mixed image and video data.
updates.benchmark_text: ImageNet-1K, Kinetics-400, Ego4D STA v1, DAVIS 2017, CATER, MVP
updates.dataset_notes: MVP denotes the simulated and real robot manipulation evaluations reported by the paper.
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv catalog entry was promoted to its final ICCV 2025 publication.

records.normalized_title: reinforcement learning meets masked video modeling trajectory guided adaptive token selection

updates.method_description: A PPO-trained trajectory-aware sampler selects informative video tokens jointly with masked-autoencoder learning.
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the ICCV 2025 Long Multi-Scene Video Foundations workshop publication.

records.normalized_title: entropy guided masked autoencoding for self supervised human action recognition using video swin transformer

updates.method_description: Optical-flow motion entropy guides which Video Swin tubelets are masked and reconstructed during self-supervised action pretraining.

records.normalized_title: privacy preservation using superimposed 3d models for self supervised training in action recognition

updates.method_description: A privacy-preserving pipeline combines MORTAL2MESH 3D overlays, K-NEXUS class sampling, and VideoMAE representation alignment.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51, Diving48, IKEA Furniture Assembly, UAV-Human, VISPR
updates.dataset_notes: Kinetics-150 is curated from Kinetics-400; M2M-Kinetics is the privacy-preserving 3D-overlay version. VISPR denotes the paper's privacy evaluation subset.

records.normalized_title: learning complementary knowledge via trusted multi view space decomposition for self supervised contrastive learning

updates.method_description: Multi-view contrastive learning decomposes shared and private spaces, estimates view trustworthiness with a Dirichlet model, and preserves topology while encouraging compactness.
updates.dataset_notes: The accessible publisher material explicitly exposes ImageNet and OGBG-MolBBBP results; the article is not limited to video benchmarks.

records.normalized_title: oskar omnimodal self supervised knowledge abstraction and representation

updates.method_description: A fuse-then-predict joint-embedding architecture learns aligned video, skeleton, and text representations with modality-specific EMA targets and fixed token budgets.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, NTU RGB+D 60, NTU RGB+D 120, AVA, MSR-VTT, MSVD, VATEX, MSR-VTT-QA, MSVD-QA, TGIF-FrameQA
updates.dataset_notes: The paper samples 10 million OpenHumanVid3 videos and derives pseudo skeleton and caption modalities before downstream evaluation.
updates.audit_notes: The NeurIPS capitalization and official proceedings link replace the earlier OpenReview PDF entry.

records.normalized_title: mme video representation learning as world model for understanding and planning

updates.method_description: Masked representation learning reconstructs appearance together with dense long-term motion trajectories encoded from optical flow, position transitions, and trajectory-aligned HOG features.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, AVA, Robot arm manipulation benchmark
updates.dataset_notes: The accessible primary abstract describes a robot-arm manipulation task but does not name that benchmark.
updates.audit_notes: Exact-title verification found only the TechRxiv record; a related earlier MME paper has a different title and was not treated as the final version.

records.normalized_title: hashtag2action data engineering and self supervised pre training for action recognition in short form videos

updates.method_description: A hashtag-driven short-video collection and cleaning pipeline supplies domain-specific data for VideoMAE V2 self-supervised pretraining.
updates.dataset_notes: Hashtag2Action contains 283,582 short-form clips in 386 action categories.

records.normalized_title: kdhiera boosting self supervised masked video modeling via hierarchical knowledge distillation

updates.method_description: A hierarchical vision transformer combines high-ratio attention-guided masking with multi-layer feature distillation from off-the-shelf image and video teachers.

records.normalized_title: self supervised video representation learning based on foreground and temporal information

updates.method_description: A self-supervised branch combines foreground extraction with temporal-information prediction before transferring the encoder to action recognition.
updates.dataset_notes: The proceedings metadata names UCF101, HMDB51, and an author-built dataset but does not expose a public name for the latter.

records.normalized_title: feature hallucination for self supervised action recognition

updates.method_description: A multimodal translational framework hallucinates complementary optical-flow, object, skeleton, and audio features from RGB using modality-specific dense and semantic distillation.
updates.benchmark_text: HMDB51, YUP++, MPII Cooking Activities, Charades, EPIC-KITCHENS-55, Toyota Smarthome, Kinetics-400, Kinetics-600, Something-Something V2
updates.dataset_notes: Kinetics-400, COCO/AVA, and Kinetics-Skeletons supply the pretrained auxiliary modality teachers used by the hallucination framework.
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the 2025 IJCV version of record.

records.normalized_title: vidrop video dense representation through spatio temporal sparsity

updates.method_description: Dense video representation learning uses spatiotemporally sparse inputs and reconstruction objectives to retain local detail while exploiting pretrained video encoders.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, THUMOS14, ImageNet-1K, DAVIS, VSC23
updates.audit_notes: The existing generic CVPR label was corrected to CVPR Workshops 2025.

records.normalized_title: sf2t self supervised fragment finetuning of video llms for fine grained understanding

updates.method_description: Self-supervised fragment fine-tuning constructs hard temporal fragments and trains video-language models to distinguish fine-grained event ordering and boundaries.
updates.dataset_notes: FineVidBench is assembled from Something-Something V2, Moments in Time, and Ego4D fragments.

records.normalized_title: v jepa 2 self supervised video models enable understanding prediction and planning

updates.method_description: A large joint-embedding predictive video model predicts masked latent representations; an action-conditioned post-training stage adapts it for planning and robot control.
updates.benchmark_text: Something-Something V2, Diving48, Jester, Kinetics-400, COIN, ImageNet-1K, EPIC-KITCHENS-100, Perception Test, MVP, TempCompass, TemporalBench, TOMATO, MVBench, TVBench, DROID
updates.dataset_notes: VideoMix22M combines the listed image and video sources; DROID is used for action-conditioned robot post-training rather than foundation pretraining.
updates.audit_notes: No later peer-reviewed exact-title publication was found as of the verification date.

records.normalized_title: when the future becomes the past taming temporal correspondence for self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: Temporal correspondence regularization learns fine-grained pixel and region features by matching future and past observations without collapsing onto static shortcuts.

records.normalized_title: self supervised learning of motion concepts by optimizing counterfactuals

updates.method_description: A counterfactual world-model objective optimizes interventions on video inputs so latent prediction must encode object motion and physical correspondences.
updates.benchmark_text: TAP-Vid DAVIS, TAP-Vid Kinetics, TAP-Vid Kubric
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to NeurIPS 2025 using the official conference listing and OpenReview record.

records.normalized_title: label ranker self aware preference for classification label position in visual masked self supervised pre trained model

updates.method_description: Linear discriminant analysis and unsupervised clustering rank classification label positions for adapting masked image and video pretrained models.

records.normalized_title: autossvh exploring automated frame sampling for efficient self supervised video hashing

updates.method_description: An adversarially optimized frame sampler, component voting, and point-to-set contrastive hashing learn efficient binary video retrieval codes.

records.normalized_title: efficient self supervised video hashing with selective state spaces

updates.method_description: Selective state-space sequence modeling learns compact self-supervised video hashes while selecting informative temporal content efficiently.

records.normalized_title: exemplar free class incremental action recognition based on self supervised learning

updates.method_description: A jointly self-supervised and supervised frozen feature extractor supports class increments using stored class statistics and pseudo-feature replay instead of video exemplars.

records.normalized_title: learning from streaming video with orthogonal gradients

updates.method_description: Streaming self-supervised optimization projects each gradient away from a compact basis of prior gradients to reduce catastrophic interference without replay.
updates.dataset_notes: WalkingTours is the paper's Venice walking-tour stream; ImageNet-21K supplies the initialization used in future-prediction experiments.
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the official CVPR 2025 publication.

records.normalized_title: intuitive physics understanding emerges from self supervised pretraining on natural videos

updates.method_description: Frozen V-JEPA representations are probed with violation-of-expectation tests and controlled ablations to study whether physical concepts emerge from natural-video pretraining.
updates.dataset_notes: The three pretraining sources form the VideoMix2M mixture used by the evaluated V-JEPA model.
updates.audit_notes: No later peer-reviewed exact-title publication was found as of the verification date.

records.normalized_title: st hvit spatial temporal hierarchical vision transformer for action recognition

updates.method_description: A two-stream spatial-temporal hierarchical vision transformer uses masked-autoencoder pretraining and a multi-scale convolutional decoder.
updates.audit_notes: The DOI suffix contains 2024, but the publisher citation and volume assign the article to 2025.

records.normalized_title: advancing video self supervised learning via image foundation models

updates.method_description: Frozen CLIP, MAE, or DINOv2 spatial features are paired with a lightweight ResNet3D temporal module trained through playback-rate perception.
updates.benchmark_text: UCF101, HMDB51, Diving48, Something-Something V2, Kinetics-400
updates.dataset_notes: ImageNet-1K is the source pretraining benchmark for the frozen image foundation models; the video datasets support self-supervised adaptation and evaluation.

records.normalized_title: smile infusing spatial and motion semantics in masked video learning

updates.method_description: Masked video learning combines a CLIP spatial-semantic teacher with synthetic object-motion supervision to encode appearance and motion jointly.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, FineGYM, GYM99, EPIC-KITCHENS-100, Charades, FX-S1, UB-S1, UCF-RC, DAVIS, YouTube-VOS, THUMOS14, ActivityNet v1.3
updates.dataset_notes: Places-80K and noise sources are used in synthetic-motion ablations. The long evaluation list includes the SEVERE robustness suite.
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the official CVPR 2025 publication.

records.normalized_title: a large scale analysis on contextual self supervised video representation learning

updates.method: Contextual VideoSSL Benchmark and Multi-Teacher Distillation
updates.method_description: A controlled large-scale study benchmarks contextual video SSL factors and distills complementary representations from multiple pretrained teachers.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, Diving48
updates.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the CVPR 2025 TCV workshop publication.

records.normalized_title: progressive self supervised spatio temporal feature learning based on video sequence saliency

updates.method_description: Video sequence saliency scores order-prediction difficulty and creates a progressive curriculum for clip-order self-supervised spatiotemporal learning.
updates.dataset_notes: The publisher abstract confirms clip/video retrieval and action-recognition experiments. UCF101, HMDB51, and Kinetics are the benchmark definitions present in the publisher metadata; the closed full text prevents a more granular split assignment.
updates.audit_notes: The conference occurred in December 2024, while the citable SPIE proceedings version was published in March 2025; the catalog follows the version-of-record year.

records.normalized_title: crossvideomae self supervised image video representation learning with masked autoencoders

updates.method_description: Cross-modal masked autoencoding aligns image and video representations using paired video clips and sampled still frames with shared and modality-specific objectives.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, ImageNet-1K
updates.dataset_notes: Sampled frames from Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2 form the image side of joint pretraining; ImageNet-1K is used as an auxiliary image benchmark.
updates.audit_notes: A personal-page reference to a medical workshop was not matched by official proceedings; the exact-title record remains a preprint.

records.normalized_title: motion driven adaptive frame selection strategy for video action recognition

updates.venue: EURASIP Journal on Image and Video Processing 2025
updates.venue_normalized: EURASIP Journal on Image and Video Processing
updates.method_description: Motion-difference entropy and an adaptive selector retain frames with informative temporal change before action classification.
updates.dataset_notes: The selector uses an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 backbone and is evaluated on three action-recognition datasets.
updates.audit_notes: The Research Square preprint link was replaced by the 2025 journal version of record.

records.normalized_title: mitigating background bias in self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: Foreground motion is blended through frame-difference masks, and transformation-multiplier prediction plus spatial, temporal, and contrastive tasks discourages background shortcuts.
updates.dataset_notes: The publisher abstract reports UCF101, HMDB51, and Diving48 under low-resource and full-compute settings.
updates.audit_notes: The article was published online in December 2024 but is cited in volume 19 as a 2025 article; the catalog follows the publisher citation year.

records.normalized_title: arvideo autoregressive pretraining for self supervised video representation learning

updates.method_description: Autoregressive learning predicts clustered spatiotemporal visual tokens under randomized prediction orders rather than fixed raster order.
updates.benchmark_text: Kinetics-400, Something-Something V2, UCF101, HMDB51, AVA v2.2
updates.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv paper was promoted to its TMLR 2025 publication.

records.normalized_title: learning video representations without natural videos

updates.method_description: VideoMAE is pretrained on progressively richer procedurally generated motion videos and crops of natural still images, without natural video pretraining.
updates.dataset_notes: UCF101-P contains 14 out-of-distribution corruption sets.
updates.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv record was promoted to the ICCV 2025 LIMIT workshop publication.

records.normalized_title: collaboratively self supervised video representation learning for action recognition

updates.venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security 2025
updates.method_description: Three collaborative branches learn future poses with a GAN, match current-future context, and generate current and future clips.
updates.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv record was promoted to the 2025 IEEE TIFS version of record.
